subject: Coordination: security intake (SOC2 / DPA / pen-test) for Olive Payments
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@olivepayments.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: samir@fortbridge.io
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: security intake (SOC2 / DPA / pen test)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick intro via LinkedIn last week. Olive Payments is kicking off procurement for our payments platform and we need a combined security/compliance walkthrough so we can:

- Confirm SOC 2 scope for our card-processing components
- Walk through Redwood's DPA terms and data handling
- Understand the pen-test plan and vendor expectations (preflight)

Goal: single 60–90 minute session to align legal, infosec, and engineering. Our initial availability: Wed 29 Jul 14:00–16:00 PDT or Thu 30 Jul 09:00–11:00 PDT. We're flexible if you have a preferred block.

A few asks ahead of the call: sample evidence list (SOC2), DPA draft, and any pre-pen-test checklist so we can prep infra and vendor. Samir from FortBridge (cc'd) is our pen-test integrator — he can help coordinate scope.

Thanks,
Sonia Patel
Head of Engineering — Olive Payments
sonia@olivepayments.com
+1 415-555-0132

--

Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: security intake (SOC2 / DPA / pen test)

Hi Sonia — great to meet you and thanks for the context. We can absolutely run a combined intake that covers SOC 2 scoping, a DPA walkthrough, and a pen-test preflight. Quick notes and proposal: 

1) Proposed slots (PDT):
   • Wed 29 Jul 15:00–16:30 (90m)
   • Thu 30 Jul 09:30–10:30 (60m)
   • Fri 31 Jul 08:00–09:00 (60m, early option)

2) Who to include: Legal (for DPA), one engineer (infra), pen-test vendor rep. Rishi (cc'd) will handle SOC 2 scoping and evidence mapping.

3) Prep we will share (attached): security-intake-playbook.pdf — includes sample evidence list, typical SOC 2 controls we cover, and a pre-pen-test checklist. Please skim and flag anything specific to your card-processing flow.

4) Outcome: a mutual action plan that calls out: scope, evidence owners, pen-test timing, and next procurement steps.

If any of those slots work, say which and we'll send an invite with the agenda. If you prefer a shorter call + separate follow-ups, we can do a 45m kickoff and a 30m pen-test deep-dive.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick note from the pen-test side. Olive: we have an internal vendor demo that conflicts with the 29 Jul 15:00 slot; Thu 30 Jul 09:30 PDT works for our calendar but I'd like to add Marissa (cc) from Redwood — she runs pen-test ops and will help define test windows and talk vendor SLAs.

Marissa — brief intro: I'm Samir (FortBridge). Olive is aiming to align SOC2 evidence owners and a pre-pen-test checklist before authorizing scope. If you can bring the standard pen-test runbook and an example NDA/SOW cadence, that will speed decisions.

Sonia/Kimberly: if Thu 30 Jul 09:30–10:30 PDT is good, I'll block FortBridge and prepare the draft SOW template.

Cheers,
